% Built by a job of test/run.mjs. imakeidx's index with a makeindex style
% that is missing, and glossaries with a style file that is missing, so
% makeindex fails for both. Each has its sorted file beside the document
% from an earlier build, with hyperref's \hyperpage, which the document no
% longer defines, and an entry the document no longer has. No LaTeX run
% reads those files.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{imakeidx}
\makeindex[options=-s test-staleaux-ind-gone]
\usepackage{glossaries}
\noist
\setStyleFile{test-staleaux-ind-gone}
\makeglossaries
\newglossaryentry{fruit}{name={fruit},description={the seed-bearing part of a plant}}
\begin{document}
An apple\index{Apple} is a \gls{fruit}.
\printindex
\printglossary
\end{document}
